excluded_subtrees.reason: Packet and protocol campaigns are owned by NET-100 behind readiness gate G12; audited 2026-08-28 as containing no untrusted-file parser (write-only ofstream in DedicatedServer.cpp only). 2026-09-27: SecureHandshake.cpp (NET-100 handshake core) is the ninth hidden candidate. It decodes untrusted network bytes, not files: fixed-size ClientHello/ServerHello records checked for exact length and magic before any field is read. This exclusion waives only its classification; its fuzz target remains open NET-100 protocol-campaign work. NetworkTrustStore.cpp is the tenth: it parses local per-user files (96-byte identity file; known_hosts capped at 1 MiB/4096 strict lines, fail-closed), tested by Transport_TrustStore_; fuzzing ParseKnownHosts is open NET-100 work.

AngelScript campaigns are owned by ENG-200 behind readiness gate G11. This subtree does ingest untrusted .as files from disk (AngelScriptEngine::CompileScriptFile -> AddSectionFromFile); that file surface is explicitly ENG-200's, not unowned. The .vscript graph decoder in this subtree is not waived: it is the inventoried visual-script-graph parser.
